Effect.description:
How the trusted state changes after a tool call succeeds.

Examples (YAML)::

    - set: identity_verified        # literal value
      value: true
      when: result.verified == true # only if the tool's result says so

    - set: order_total              # copy a value out of the tool's result
      from: result.total

set.description: Name of the state variable to change.
set.title: Set

value.description: Literal value to store. Use null to unset.
value.title: Value

from.description: Copy the value from the tool call: 'result.<field>' or 'args.<name>'.
from.title: From

when.description: Optional condition (may use result.*, args.*, state.*). The effect only applies if it holds.
when.title: When

Effect.title: Effect
